newsitem.title: USA: America Online unit, NYNEX in pact.
newsitem.headline: America Online unit, NYNEX in pact.

text.p: America Online Inc's network service unit ANS Communications Inc said Tuesday it had agreed to a comprehensive relationship with NYNEX Corp.

NYNEX will resell existing ANS services, ANS will support intranet and extranet connections to NYNEX business customers over the ANSnet Internet backbone network, and the two will collaborate on a number of joint development and marketing initiatives, ANS said.
Intranets are internal corporate networks designed along Internet standards. Extranets are private, Internet-based networks that connect a company to suppliers and customers.

"Today's announcement represents the first time an RBOC and an ISP have partnered to provide customers with a one-stop shopping solution for their information services," ANS Chief Executive Bruce Bond said in a statement.
"Importantly, this alliance promises to increase ANS's penetration into the Fortune 1000," he said.

As part of the alliance, NYNEX will develop a customized global extranet for financial services companies through partnerships with ANS, Sun Microsystems Inc and Avesta. The system will be marketed through NYNEX.
NYNEX announced its planned entry into the intranet/extranet market at the Securities Industry Association Information Management Conference in New York on Tuesday.
